independence: Reviewer did not author the 19 building GLBs or capture this runtime scene. Earlier frontend contract tests and evidence audit are separate work.
scope: Visible native identity/massing, visible ground contact, and obvious runtime regression in 19 supplied app captures compared with 57 exact locked references. Category closure only.

provenance.reference_resolution: Exact SHA-matching bytes resolved from assets-final/public, repository, Git LFS cache or immutable candidate sources; no pointer file treated as an image.
provenance.model_binding_limit: Expected model hashes copied from selected seed identities. Capture/model binding is supplied by the runtime capture owner; this visual review did not independently download/re-hash mounted GLBs.

limitations: Not a holistic review of every model view or keeper-quality materials. Architectural-clay simplification is the declared delivery profile.
Single elevated/front captures cannot prove hidden or partly obscured relationships. Candidate-specific unproven relationships remain open.
No obvious floating/sunk base in visible pixels does not establish complete footprint, slopes or measured ground support.
This review does not test keyboard walking, app controls, download completion or runtime scale numerically.

Comparison boards preserve the full capture at native pixel dimensions but are JPEG derivatives. All 19 boards were directly inspected; seven flagged views were additionally reopened as original PNGs. References were compared in uncropped scaled panels.
No library flags, lifecycle records, prior reviews or human approvals were changed.

generated_artifacts.policy: External analytical comparison boards; original captures and sources preserved.
